mapper.sql: l.id, l.user_id, COALESCE(up.nickname, u.username) AS username, up.avatar_url AS avatar, l.poi_id AS spotId, l.poi_id AS spot_id, p.name AS location, l.circle_id, l.itinerary_plan_id AS itineraryPlanId, ip.title AS itineraryPlanTitle, ip.city AS itineraryPlanCity, ip.duration AS itineraryPlanDuration, ip.spot_count AS itineraryPlanSpotCount, ip.summary AS itineraryPlanSummary, l.title, l.content, l.content_compressed, l.content_encoding, l.content_original_size, l.content_compressed_size, l.rating, l.scenery_rating, l.facility_rating, l.service_rating, l.traffic_rating, l.value_rating, l.hotness, l.view_count, l.is_top, l.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM log_likes ll WHERE ll.log_id = l.id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM log_comments lc WHERE lc.log_id = l.id AND lc.status = 1) AS comment_count, CASE WHEN my_like.user_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_liked

FROM travel_logs l JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.id = l.poi_id LEFT JOIN itinerary_plans ip ON ip.id = l.itinerary_plan_id AND ip.status = 1 LEFT JOIN log_likes my_like ON my_like.log_id = l.id AND my_like.user_id = #{currentUserId}
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY l.is_top DESC, l.hotness DESC, like_count DESC, l.created_at DESC
ORDER BY l.is_top DESC, l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_logs SET view_count = view_count + 1, hotness = hotness + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO log_images (log_id, image_url, sort_order) VALUES (#{logId}, #{imageUrl}, #{sortOrder})
INSERT IGNORE INTO tags (name, tag_type) VALUES (#{name}, 'log')
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tags WHERE name = #{name} AND tag_type = 'log'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO log_tag_relations (log_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{logId}, #{tagId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_logs WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
SELECT user_id FROM travel_logs WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
SELECT user_id AS userId, title, content FROM travel_logs WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
SELECT poi_id FROM travel_logs WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_logs SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE spots s JOIN pois p ON p.id = #{poiId} AND p.status = 1 SET s.rating = p.rating WHERE s.status = 1 AND ( s.id = p.spot_id OR s.representative_poi_id = p.id OR s.legacy_poi_id = p.id )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO log_comments (log_id, user_id, parent_id, content) VALUES (#{logId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM log_comments WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
SELECT log_id FROM log_comments WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE log_comments SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.log_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, COALESCE(up.nickname, u.username) AS username, up.avatar_url AS avatar, c.content, c.created_at FROM log_comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = u.id WHERE c.log_id = #{logId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id), c.parent_id IS NOT NULL, c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC
